title: Exact Durable Reservation Acceptance Evidence Read
purpose: Provide the first public read-only consumer seam for one exact durably persisted reservation-acceptance identity/version. Reconstruct and authenticate the complete FOOD-007Y durable evidence value from immutable acceptance evidence plus authoritative reservation storage without trusting process-memory FOOD-005L or FOOD-007W objects.
decomposition: FOOD-007Z owns exact durable acceptance evidence retrieval and authentication only. It does not own checkout readiness, payment readiness, payment status, order-state mutation, reservation mutation, reservation release, preparation authority, dispatch authority, fulfillment authority, completed-sale authority, inventory truth, accounting or rewards.

reasonForNextUnit.food007yGap: FOOD-007Y establishes durable persistence and returns evidence during persistence, but its public API exposes no independent durable read operation for a later process/request.
reasonForNextUnit.readinessGap: No current FOOD runtime contract owns combined checkout/payment/fulfillment readiness. A future readiness projection therefore needs an authoritative durable acceptance input seam before composition.
reasonForNextUnit.orderStateBoundary: FOOD-005E remains requested/cancelled only. FOOD-007Z must not invent accepted, paid, confirmed, preparing, ready, dispatched or completed order states.
reasonForNextUnit.noMigration: FOOD-007Z reads existing immutable tables created by migrations 0003, 0006 and 0007. No schema change or migration 0008 is required.

food005l.role: Canonical FoodReservationAcceptanceId, FoodReservationAcceptanceVersion, parser and validation semantics.

food007y.role: Canonical durable evidence value shape, persistence semantics and acceptance evidence table.

reservationStorage.role: Authoritative immutable reservation parent, canonical demand lines and fulfillment-slot claim.

fulfillmentIntentBinding.role: Authoritative immutable reservation-to-fulfillment-intent ID/version binding required to reconstruct the FOOD-005L acceptance snapshot.

lookup.authority: Exact caller-supplied acceptance identity/version is a lookup key only. It grants no commerce authority.
lookup.acceptanceVersion: Positive safe-integer exact version. Current durable FOOD-007Y schema contains version 1 only; any absent exact version returns not-found rather than inferring latest/current.
lookup.noReservationIdInferenceFromCaller: The caller does not supply the authoritative reservation ID. The exact acceptance evidence row supplies reservation_id, which must then authenticate against authoritative reservation storage.

outcomeSemantics.found: One exact acceptance evidence row exists, its reservation relationship and all required durable reservation children authenticate, the complete canonical FOOD-005L acceptance can be reconstructed exactly, and a detached deeply frozen FOOD-007Y evidence value is returned.
outcomeSemantics.not-found: No durable acceptance evidence row exists for the exact canonical acceptance ID/version. Do not infer another version, latest acceptance, reservation acceptance, or readiness.
outcomeSemantics.storage-failure: The acceptance evidence row exists but required authoritative reservation storage is missing, malformed, internally inconsistent, cannot reconstruct the exact canonical acceptance, or a database read fails.
outcomeSemantics.invalid: The supplied acceptance identity/version is malformed, hostile or otherwise cannot be safely interpreted as an exact lookup.

authoritativeRead.reservationIdentity: Take reservation_id only from the exact durable acceptance evidence row.
authoritativeRead.parentRequirement: A found acceptance row requires exactly one corresponding authoritative reservation parent.
authoritativeRead.lineRequirement: Reconstruct capacity requirements in persisted line_index order. Never sort, repair or canonicalize a different order.
authoritativeRead.slotRequirement: Require the exact durable fulfillment-slot claim for method/locationReference/windowReference.
authoritativeRead.fulfillmentBindingRequirement: Require the exact FOOD-007X fulfillment-intent ID/version binding.
authoritativeRead.demandIntegrity: Authenticate persisted canonical demand and reservation lines using the same durable semantics established by FOOD-007Y. Missing or contradictory storage is storage-failure.
authoritativeRead.acceptanceReconstruction: Combine exact acceptance ID/version and metadata from FOOD-007Y with exact authoritative order/request/fulfillment/demand facts from reservation storage, then validate the reconstructed FoodReservationAcceptanceVersion using canonical FOOD-005L validation.
authoritativeRead.output: Return FOOD-007Y FoodDurableReservationAcceptanceEvidence with durable reservationId plus reconstructed acceptance.

readOnlyBoundary.mutationRecovery: Not applicable. This unit never performs a write.

immutability.detachment: Returned values must not retain caller-owned or database-row mutable references.
immutability.deepFreeze: Found evidence and all nested acceptance data must be deeply frozen.

hostileShapePolicy.accessorInvocation: Do not invoke hostile getter/setter properties while validating caller-supplied lookup input.
hostileShapePolicy.symbols: Reject unsupported symbol-keyed shape where object input is inspected.
hostileShapePolicy.customPrototype: Reject unsupported custom-prototype object input where applicable.
hostileShapePolicy.arrays: No array lookup input is accepted.
hostileShapePolicy.repair: Never repair malformed caller input or malformed durable rows.

invariants: durable acceptance persistence != durable acceptance read
found durable acceptance != physical inventory truth

future.readiness: A later pure readiness composition may consume one FOOD-007Z found durable acceptance alongside exact non-cancelled order truth, exact payable/payment truth and other independently established policy gates.
future.lifecycle: Reservation release/expiration/cancellation/consumption remain separate future operational boundaries.
future.orderState: Any expansion beyond FOOD-005E requested/cancelled requires its own deliberate lifecycle contract.
future.migration: No migration 0008 is created or implied by FOOD-007Z.
